subject: Security questionnaire kickoff & field scoping for FinServ Analytics
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finserv-analytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Security questionnaire kickoff & field scoping for FinServ Analytics

Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) Redwood will initiate the standard SIG/CAIQ questionnaire (we typically start with SIG v1.2). I’ve attached the SIG bundle and a lightweight guide that highlights the fields companies commonly ask us to prioritize.
2) Clarifying questions for your team so we scope this correctly:
   - Is this intake focused on the SOC 2 report evidence (Type I/II) or the full SOC 2 questionnaire?
   - Do you need HIPAA BAA coverage (we support BAA-ready flows for data in dedicated/private deployments)?
   - Any strict data residency constraints (EU, APAC) for the systems that will be in scope?
   - Do you prefer we provide a completed SIG first-pass or just the evidentiary artifacts and a contact for follow-up?

Proposed timeline: we can return a first-pass completed SIG + evidence annotations within 4 business days after you confirm scope and preferred SIG version. If you want us to redact anything, please indicate which artifact types (e.g., IP, employee PII) up front.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_v1.2.pdf (SIG questionnaire), redwood-data-flow-diagram.png (high-level)

Next steps: please confirm (a) SIG version, (b) HIPAA/BAA requirement, and (c) target completion date.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finserv-analytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Carter <john.carter@finserv-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kickoff & field scoping for FinServ Analytics

Thanks Rishi — useful summary. Quick answers below: 

- We need the full SIG + SOC 2 evidence for our procurement review. SOC 2 Type II is preferred but we will accept Type I with a remediation plan if Type II is not available.
- Yes, HIPAA is in scope for a subset of data flows (sending PHI from provider to our ingestion pipeline). We will need a BAA before we go-live.
- Data residency: primary requirement is US, but some customers are EU; for now scope US systems.
- First-pass completed SIG is preferred — our security team likes to see answers populated and references to artifacts so they can fast-review.

Timeline: target internal review by 05/03/2026. If you can deliver a first-pass by 04/28 that would be ideal.

One clarification: on the SIG fields, do you populate subprocessor names or provide a redacted list? Also, are you able to mark which controls map to SOC 2 controls in your response?

I’ve attached our intake form (FinServ_Security_Intake.xlsx) — it includes our procurement contact and a checkbox for HIPAA.

— Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Vendor Security & Risk | FinServ Analytics
elena.ruiz@finserv-analytics.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finserv-analytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kickoff & field scoping for FinServ Analytics

Elena — great, thank you for the clarifications. A few answers and notes: 

- SOC 2: we have a current SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2026-02-28). We will include the summary report and the control mappings. If you need the full bridge letter or scope addenda, we can provide that as well under an NDA or secure upload.
- HIPAA: we can sign a BAA. For the SIG, we’ll flag the HIPAA-relevant controls and include our HIPAA controls crosswalk in the evidence folder.
- Subprocessors: we provide a list of subprocessors; PII-sensitive contracts are redacted in public copies but we will provide a complete list through your secure intake channel. Please confirm preferred upload (Secure Drive link you provided vs. vendor portal).
- Control mapping: yes — we annotate SIG answers with SOC 2 control IDs and evidence references (e.g., "CC6.2 -> redwood-rotating-keys.pdf").

Action plan from our side:
1) I’ll upload a first-pass populated SIG (version 1.2) with inline control mapping and attach the SOC 2 summary report by 2026-04-28.
2) Monica (copied) will share the secure upload link and instructions for redaction/PII handling.
3) Lauren (copied) will coordinate BAA language and next steps for execution.

If that works, we’ll proceed and I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the artifacts and timeline.

— Rishi

On attachments: I’m attaching a short "SIG completion guide" (one page) that explains our typical approach and which fields usually require follow-up.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finserv-analytics.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kickoff & field scoping for FinServ Analytics

Elena — for secure uploads please use the shared FinServ folder on our S3-backed secure drive (link: https://redwood.example.com/shared/drive/FinServ-SIG-folder). We’ve enabled a short-lived presigned upload token for your security team — I’ll DM the token to your procurement inbox.

Regarding subprocessor disclosure: we will supply the canonical subprocessors.csv file through the secure folder; if you need fully unredacted agreements we can provide them under a mutual NDA and controlled access.

On redaction guidance: please flag any items you need redacted in a single checklist file and we’ll remove PII before internal distribution.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Security & Trust Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finserv-analytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Carter <john.carter@finserv-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kickoff & field scoping for FinServ Analytics

Thanks all — confirming we’ll accept first-pass delivered to the secure drive. Our procurement contact will upload the intake form and mark HIPAA as in-scope.

One small clarification before you start: John (cc’d) asked whether Redwood will complete the "physical security" section directly or whether you expect us to accept attachments (photos/floor plans). For speed, it would be helpful if you could populate the fields and attach the supporting artifacts rather than expecting our team to supplement.

Target: please submit first-pass SIG + SOC 2 summary to the secure folder by 04/28. If anything blocks you, flag it here and we’ll triage.

— Elena
